normalizationRule: Numbers, punctuation, symbols, whitespace and case are normalized before duplicate comparison.
semanticRule: subject + unit + skill + task + context combination must be unique
curriculumSource: MEB Türkiye Yüzyılı Maarif Modeli 9. sınıf öğretim programları
note: Automated semantic checks cannot mathematically prove human-level meaning uniqueness; V23 was rewritten to remove known repeated verbal stems and cosmetic numeric copies, and runtime QA rejects exact, normalized and semantic-key duplicates.
